Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 19
Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscalculated the lifespans despite having correct dates. Antonio Caggiano (1889-01-30 to 1979-10-23) lived about 90.7 years, while Hardyal Singh (1928-11-28 to 2018-08-17) lived about 89.7 years. The Planner incorrectly stated Antonio’s lifespan as ~89 years and Hardyal’s as ~90 years—contradicting both the exact dates gathered and even a snippet indicating Hardyal’s age at death was 89—leading to the wrong conclusion that Hardyal Singh lived longer.
